name: Breakwater Undertow door
notes: The iron door at the foot of the harbour-wall stair on the breakwater, into the smugglers' tunnel to the Undertow (mw-e40.1, route is mw-e40.12; route-matrix undertow): a tier-2 lock a thief picks, a knight bursts. No key lies about.
hint: Barred from the tunnel side. Wet bootprints lead in.
